title: [Feature Refactoring] Check autocast dtypes on all supported devices; restore nesting around AOT traces
body:
## Summary
AOTAutograd metadata collection used to snapshot autocast dtype only for CUDA and CPU. The snapshot now walks `torch._C._autocast_supported_devices()` and records each device's autocast **dtype**.
During `run_functionalized_fw_and_collect_metadata`:
- Compare dtypes after the traced forward (inside `ExcludeDispatchKeyGuard`).
- If any supported device's dtype changed, raise with a per-device diff.
- Always restore prior dtypes and autocast nesting via `_preserve_autocast_dtypes` / `_preserve_autocast_nesting`.
**Enabled-state mutations are not checked.** `ExcludeDispatchKeyGuard` restores autocast enabled TLS on exit.
**Nesting is restored, not raised on.** Dynamo intentionally emits unbalanced `autocast_increment_nesting` / `autocast_decrement_nesting` across graph breaks. `_create_graph` also wraps `make_fx` in `_preserve_autocast_nesting()` so metadata collect and graph capture both reset nesting at compile time (previously capture could leave the counter changed).
Prefer `with torch.autocast(...)` so dtype is restored before the graph exits. An unbalanced `_enter_autocast` that also changes dtype still fails the dtype check (including across graph breaks). Expanding the dtype check beyond CPU/CUDA is user-visible for non-CUDA/CPU backends under AOT; maintainer sign-off and a `release notes:` label are still needed for that part.
## Changes
- `torch/amp/autocast_mode.py`: shared `_get_autocast_nesting` / `_set_autocast_nesting` / `_preserve_autocast_nesting`.
- `torch/_dynamo/test_case.py`: use the shared nesting helpers.
- `torch/_functorch/_aot_autograd/utils.py`: `_get_autocast_dtypes()` / `_preserve_autocast_dtypes()`.
- `torch/_functorch/_aot_autograd/collect_metadata_analysis.py`: dtype compare + preserve dtypes/nesting around the metadata forward.
- `torch/_functorch/_aot_autograd/graph_capture.py`: preserve nesting around `make_fx` in `_create_graph`.
- `torch/_functorch/aot_autograd.py`: export `_get_autocast_dtypes`.
- `test/functorch/test_aotdispatch.py`: `TestAOTAutocastStates` (all supported devices + aot_eager graph-break nesting).
- `test/dynamo/test_test_case.py`: call nesting helpers via `torch.amp.autocast_mode`.
## Test Plan
```bash
python test/functorch/test_aotdispatch.py TestAOTAutocastStates -v
python test/dynamo/test_test_case.py -v
```
